# Musoftwares - AI Agent Guide & Directory

> Official index of services, plugins, and blog resources for LLMs and AI Agents.

## Platform Overview
Musoftwares provides professional web development, automation playbooks, SaaS plugins, and custom software services.
Base URL: http://localhost
Full Comprehensive Index: http://localhost/llms-full.txt

## Machine Readable Endpoints
- Services API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/services
- Categories API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/categories
- Search API: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/search
- OpenAPI Spec: http://localhost/marketplace/api/v1/openapi.json

## Developer Note for Crawlers
All endpoints automatically negotiate content and deliver pure JSON payload containing the full page props when accessed by AI user-agents or with `?format=json`.

- [Web Development](http://localhost/marketplace/categories/web-development): Discover services in this category.
